Classroom Spy is a classroom monitoring and management software that allows teachers or administrators to monitor computers connected to the same network. It can typically be used to view student screens, track computer activity, manage applications, and assist with classroom instruction and supervision.

Hard Disk Sentinel (HDD Sentinel) is a hard drive and SSD monitoring and diagnostic utility. It checks the health, temperature, performance, and SMART status of storage devices and can detect potential problems before data loss occurs. It is useful for monitoring drive reliability and diagnosing storage issues.

Victoria HDD is a hard drive diagnostic and testing utility used to check the health and performance of HDDs and SSDs. It can scan drives for bad sectors, test read/write performance, monitor SMART information, and help identify storage problems.

CrystalDiskMark is a disk benchmarking utility used to measure the read and write performance of HDDs, SSDs, and other storage devices. It helps determine storage speed and compare the performance of different drives.

CrystalDiskInfo is a disk monitoring and diagnostic utility that provides detailed information about HDDs and SSDs. It displays drive health status, temperature, firmware, interface, power-on hours, and SMART data. It is useful for checking storage drive condition and detecting potential disk problems.

MemTest64 is a memory testing utility used to check a computer’s RAM for errors and stability problems. It performs tests on system memory to help identify faulty or unstable RAM that may cause crashes, freezes, blue screens, or other system issues.

HWMonitor is a hardware monitoring utility that displays real-time information about a computer’s temperatures, voltages, fan speeds, power consumption, and CPU/GPU performance. It is useful for checking system health, detecting overheating, and monitoring hardware conditions.

CPU-Z is a free system information utility that displays detailed information about a computer’s hardware. It can show the processor (CPU), motherboard, RAM, cache, and other system specifications. It is useful for checking hardware details, verifying component configurations, and troubleshooting or monitoring a PC.

Windows 10 is an operating system developed by Microsoft for computers and laptops. It provides a user-friendly interface and supports a wide range of applications, hardware, security features, networking, and multimedia functions. Windows 10 is commonly used for everyday tasks such as browsing the internet, creating documents, gaming, video editing, and managing files.

Notepad++ is a free, lightweight text and source-code editor for Windows. It supports many programming and scripting languages and provides features such as syntax highlighting, search and replace, tabs, and code editing tools.
CareUEyes Lite is an eye-care and screen-protection program that helps reduce eye strain by adjusting screen settings and reminding users to take regular breaks.

uTorrent is a BitTorrent client used to download and share files through the peer-to-peer (P2P) network. It allows users to download large files in smaller pieces from multiple peers simultaneously, which can improve download speed.

cmd_scripts.title: Check Domain / Workgroup
cmd_scripts.description: Displays the domain or workgroup associated with the computer. Useful for diagnosing Active Directory and domain-join issues.

cmd_scripts.title: Check Windows Edition
cmd_scripts.description: Displays the Windows edition, version, and build number. On newer Windows versions, PowerShell is preferred because WMIC is deprecated.

cmd_scripts.title: Windows Firewall Status
cmd_scripts.description: Displays Windows Firewall status and configuration for the Domain, Private, and Public network profiles.  Useful when troubleshooting blocked network connections.

cmd_scripts.title: Temporary File Cleanup
cmd_scripts.description: Attempts to remove files from the current user's temporary directory. Useful for freeing some disk space and cleaning temporary files.  Note: Files currently being used by applications may not be deleted.

cmd_scripts.title: Trace Network Route
cmd_scripts.description: Displays the network hops between the computer and the destination. Useful for identifying routing problems, high latency, or where connectivity is failing.

cmd_scripts.title: DNS Troubleshooting
cmd_scripts.description: Tests DNS resolution and shows which DNS server is being used to resolve a domain name.

cmd_scripts.title: Show Listening Ports
cmd_scripts.description: Shows network ports currently listening for incoming connections.

cmd_scripts.title: Network Connections
cmd_scripts.description: Displays active network connections, listening ports, local/remote addresses, and process IDs (PIDs).  Useful for network troubleshooting and identifying which processes are using network connections.

cmd_scripts.title: Check Disk Space
cmd_scripts.description: Displays available and used storage on Windows drives. Useful for identifying drives that are almost full.

cmd_scripts.title: Clear Stuck Print Queue
cmd_scripts.command:
net stop spooler
del /Q /F "%systemroot%\System32\spool\PRINTERS\*"
net start spooler
cmd_scripts.description: Stops the Print Spooler, removes pending print jobs, and starts the service again. Useful when documents are permanently stuck in the print queue.

cmd_scripts.title: Restart Print Spooler
cmd_scripts.command:
net stop spooler
net start spooler
cmd_scripts.description: Restarts the Windows Print Spooler service. Useful when printers are stuck, print jobs aren't processing, or Windows cannot communicate properly with the printer.

cmd_scripts.title: Check Disk Repair
cmd_scripts.description: Checks a drive for file-system errors and, when requested, attempts to repair them. Useful for diagnosing disk and file-system problems.

cmd_scripts.title: Repair Windows Component Store
cmd_scripts.description: Repairs the Windows component store that SFC depends on. Useful when SFC reports that it cannot repair some corrupted files.

cmd_scripts.title: Check Windows System Files
cmd_scripts.description: Scans Windows system files for corruption and automatically repairs damaged protected system files when possible.

cmd_scripts.title: Check IP / Network Configuration
cmd_scripts.description: Displays detailed network configuration, including IP address, subnet mask, gateway, DNS servers, and MAC address. Useful for diagnosing network and DHCP problems.

cmd_scripts.title: Massgrave Activator (Windows and Office)
cmd_scripts.description: Massgrave Activator – A community-developed activation toolkit associated with Microsoft Windows and Office activation. It provides various activation methods and system utilities, and is primarily used for managing activation in supported Windows and Office environments.

cmd_scripts.title: Export Detailed System Specs to Desktop
cmd_scripts.description: Exports full hardware, OS, BIOS, and memory specifications into a text file.

cmd_scripts.title: Windows Activation & License Status Check
cmd_scripts.description: Displays detailed Windows activation license status and expiration info.

cmd_scripts.title: Complete Network Stack & DNS Reset
cmd_scripts.command: ipconfig /flushdns && ipconfig /release && ipconfig /renew && netsh winsock reset && netsh int ip reset
cmd_scripts.description: Flushes DNS resolver cache, releases/renews DHCP IP lease, and resets Winsock catalog.

cmd_scripts.title: Restart Printer Spooler & Clear Queue
cmd_scripts.command: net stop spooler && del /Q /F /S "%systemroot%\System32\Spool\Printers\*.*" && net start spooler
cmd_scripts.description: Stops printer spooler, deletes stuck print jobs in queue, and restarts service.

cmd_scripts.title: Windows System File Checker & Repair
cmd_scripts.description: Scans and repairs corrupted Windows system files and system image.
